description: Convert data between JSON, YAML, CSV, and XML formats

from.description: Format of the input: json, yaml, csv, xml, text (or string), or base64. Unsupported formats return 400.

to.description: Target format: json, yaml, csv or xml when from is a structured format; base64 or hex when from is text; text (or string) or hex when from is base64. Unsupported targets return 400.

name: convert-format
